# Version 4.155.0 (Unreleased)
> **Linux fonts and Tizen**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp restores Linux system-font discovery for NoDependencies deployments and adds Tizen 10 native packages. Linux applications using the NoDependencies package can again resolve installed system fonts, while Tizen 10 gains current native builds and packaging support.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Linux NoDependencies fonts discovered** — Linux applications using the NoDependencies package can again discover installed system fonts through the font manager. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5086))

## Platform

- **Tizen 10 native builds and packages** — Tizen 10 now receives native builds and packaging produced with its GCC 14.2 toolchain. ([#5235](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5235))
